component.name: Wallpaper-Controls
component.summary: Choose how wallpapers appear on GNOME desktops

description.p: Choose how your wallpaper fits the screen: fill it, show the whole image, stretch it, keep its original size, tile it, or spread it across your monitors. Preview changes before pressing Apply.
Use different images in light and dark mode or give each monitor its own wallpaper. Choose the image position, background color, and border width, or use a solid color without an image.

Drop an image from Files to preview it. Discard Changes clears edits you haven't applied, and Restore Previous Wallpaper undoes your last wallpaper change. Show monitor numbers to identify your screens and automatically adjust saved wallpapers when your monitor setup changes.

screenshot.caption: Preview a wallpaper before applying it
Choose alignment, borders, and automatic display rebuilding

description.p: Rename the app to Wallpaper-Controls and explicitly declare its existing app icon in the catalog metadata.

Add Restore Previous Wallpaper, image position, monitor numbers, automatic monitor adjustments, drag and drop, and color-only backgrounds. Improve save recovery, image handling, and installation checks.
Use the actual display size for previews and automatically expose a selected background color when the image covers the display.
Add adjustable visible borders so the selected background color can always appear around the wallpaper.
Clarify the background color control and show when the wallpaper image covers it.
Show the app's own icon in the Ubuntu app launcher.
The window adapts to the available screen height and keeps wallpaper controls visible on smaller displays.
Initial public release with wallpaper placement, light and dark images, color selection, and per-monitor composition.
